title: WORKSHEET 11
subject: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 11: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous

sections.instruction: Use the PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS TENSE to fill in the blanks: (Example: I’m tired, because I have been working (work) very hard.)

questions.prompt: He [gap] (write) letters all morning.
Catherina is getting fatter because she [gap] (eat) too much.
My mother [gap] (peel) the potatoes all afternoon.
Cathy [gap] (attend) a cookery course since March.
How long [gap] you [gap] (learn) English?
Where are my eye-glasses? I [gap] (look) for them for an hour.
Charles [gap] (escape) from the police for years.
How long [gap] you [gap] (use) a computer?
Elizabeth [gap] (live) with Mike for three years.
She [gap] (earn) quite a lot of money for the last two years.
It [gap] (rain) for six hours.

sections.instruction: Use the PRESENT PERFECT TENSE or the PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS to fill in the blanks (choose the correct option):

questions.prompt: I [gap] a new pair of shoes.
questions.explanation: finished action with a result → present perfect

questions.prompt: [gap] reading that book yet?
They [gap] fruit all afternoon, ever since they came from school.
questions.explanation: activity over a period (all afternoon) → continuous

questions.prompt: I [gap] this book now, so you can have it back.
I [gap] eight pages already.
questions.explanation: how many / how much done → present perfect

questions.prompt: Your exam paper is completely blank! What [gap]?
questions.explanation: what activity filled that time → continuous

questions.prompt: Oh, no! There’s nothing to eat. My sister [gap] everything I left in the kitchen.
Oh, no! There’s no wine to drink. They [gap] all the wine.
No wonder your eyes hurt. You [gap] computer games ever since you had your breakfast.
questions.explanation: activity with a visible effect → continuous

questions.prompt: I [gap] you for ages.
questions.explanation: see is a state/short action → present perfect

questions.prompt: God! Hakan [gap].
They [gap] for an hour.
questions.explanation: activity over a period (for an hour) → continuous

questions.prompt: I [gap] for you for ages.
I [gap] my work.
I [gap] this letter for an hour.
questions.explanation: activity over a period (for an hour) → continuous

questions.prompt: He [gap] ten museums this week.
questions.explanation: number of completed actions → present perfect

questions.prompt: I’m very tired. Because I [gap] around Istanbul all day.
questions.explanation: activity all day, effect now → continuous

questions.prompt: She [gap] a good job.
I’m hot because I [gap].
questions.explanation: recent activity with effect now → continuous

questions.prompt: I [gap] letters for weeks.
questions.explanation: activity over a period (for weeks) → continuous
